rationale: Comparison for unit:given.typing.declarations against lean:Unique/Views:TypedClass, lean:Unique/Views:ClassTable, lean:Unique/Views:ClassTable.erase, lean:Unique/Views:ClassTable.WellFormed. TypedClass assigns a nominal class to each ordered field; ClassTable.WellFormed checks unique names and declared field targets. Erasure preserves names/order and removes field types. This agrees with using the operational unpacking extension while allowing moved fields to become empty. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:given.classes, unit:given.programs, unit:given.patterns, unit:given.unpacking.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review.
Abstract syntax and mathematical semantics; no surface parser is certified. GC is a noncomputable reachability filter. Functions safety permits divergence.
